purpose: Short screening budget for pi0.5 / SmolVLA / OpenVLA-OFT before any long training.

equal_data_exposure.definition: Number of training examples consumed by each model, independent of micro-batch or gradient accumulation.
equal_data_exposure.rationale: Matches the proven pi0.5 dataset-screen scale: 150 optimizer steps x effective batch 32 = 4800 sample visits.

equal_wall_time.definition: Measured training-loop wall time only; environment setup, source/model download, dataset staging/conversion, checkpoint merge and simulator evaluation are excluded.
equal_wall_time.rationale: Thirty minutes per candidate is roughly 3x the slowest 4800-sample pi0.5 screening run and gives the larger candidates a meaningful cost-efficiency window without turning M3 into full training.

notes: This is a screening budget, not the Run A 20k budget.
A model may complete the equal-data protocol before 1800 s; the equal-wall-time protocol is a separate run/measurement.
Do not count setup/download/conversion time as model training time.
